---
title: "Getting Started"
---

Both packages come from PyPI, and `pip install estimint mintstate` brings in the pair.
`stateMINT` is published under the distribution name `mintstate`, so the name in the install
command is not the name in the import. Python 3.12 is the minimum.

The emulator's weights are not shipped in the wheel. They are fetched from Hugging Face on first
use and cached under `~/.cache/huggingface`, which makes the first `run_scenarios` of a new
install slower than every call that follows it. Please see
[Python for Malaria Modellers](../01-python/index.qmd) if virtual environments are new.
